name: Repo-aware interactive PRD generator
description: Operators currently generate PRDs using web LLMs because it is fast, but those tools are not repo-aware and produce vague or misaligned work breakdowns. FADE should be the primary PRD authoring interface: contextual, standards-aligned, and consistent.

userStories.title: Interactive PRD creation that uses repo context
userStories.description: FADE asks context-aware questions and produces a PRD that matches FADE's schema and style.
acceptanceCriteria: Command `fade prd new` launches an interview flow that asks clarifying questions before writing a PRD.
The flow automatically references: repo structure, `FADE.md`, relevant standards, and (if present) `fade/map.md` or existing docs.
Output is a valid PRD JSON file in `fade/prds/` with properly numbered US items and acceptance criteria.
PRD includes an explicit `complexity` recommendation and stores the estimator rationale (brief) in the PRD description or a sidecar file.

userStories.title: PRD generator supports 'council' second opinions (optional)
userStories.description: For high-risk items, the operator can request second opinions from other models/providers.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD generator offers an optional `--second-opinion` flag (stub OK) that captures at least one alternative approach and risks.
Second-opinion output is stored alongside PRD in `fade/prds/_notes/` or similar.
PRD generator never blocks if second-opinion is unavailable; it degrades gracefully.
